ns2:course.label: Geochemical Reaction Analysis
ns2:course.description: (GEOL 458) Study of the chemical processes affecting fluids, sediments, and rocks of the earth's crust, with emphasis on the inorganic geochemistry of groundwater and the development and application of quantitative reaction models. Prerequisite: GEOL 460, GEOL 560, or GEOL 561, or CEE 443 or CEE 537, or consent of instructor.
